notes:
- New: Crypto is now a real asset type (Stocks / Futures / Crypto), not a fake "country" under Stocks
- New: Broker downloads now pull 1-minute data for more precise backtesting; Yahoo stays at 5-minute
- New: Multi-select indicators, with a Base (3) vs Gold (10) limit on one chart
- New: Position sizing (Capital per stock or Fixed contracts), shown live on the chart
- New: Download Strategy Description (Gold) - a formatted Word doc of everything behind a result, for taking a strategy to another platform
- Fixed: mixing different-resolution price data into one file could previously happen silently - now blocked with an explicit prompt
- Fixed: Settings changes and strategy/indicator/paintbar code edits now correctly refresh a chart that's actively showing them
- Fixed: Trade Log column sorting could crash depending on the column's underlying numeric type
- One-time: downloaded price data is being reorganized into the new folder structure - existing installs will need to re-download their data
